rules.human_representation_transport: All 104 locked human/direct cases may be compared with their deterministic human/obfuscated representations.
rules.model_representation_transport: Require semantic-equivalence case status retain; severity need not equal the base intent because direct and obfuscated model variants share the same model formulation.
rules.semantic_only_source_sensitivity: Semantic-retain cases with severity mismatch are preserved for sensitivity/standardization analysis but excluded from strict paired source q.
rules.strict_source_transport: Require semantic-equivalence retain and severity aligned before comparing human versus model source as the same harmful case.
